question.question: How do Maker bonus spice, the Shield Wall and Maker Hooks affect harvesting and summoning, and where can a sandworm be placed?

key.expected_answer: Makers phase adds one bonus spice on each unoccupied Maker space, accumulating; visiting collects all bonus spice. Shield Wall blocks worms at Arrakeen, Spice Refinery, Imperial Basin until removed to box. Maker Hooks prerequisite when specified; summoning directly bank to Conflict, never garrison.

a.answer: A visit to a Maker space takes all bonus spice there. At Makers, an Agent-free space gets one additional spice during Makers phase. Deep Desert costs 3 water and Hagga Basin costs 1 water. Worm options require Maker Hooks; a protected Conflict at Arrakeen, Spice Refinery, or Imperial Basin cannot receive a summoned worm while the Shield Wall remains. The usual sandworm icon may require Hooks if printed as a condition, but Hooks are not universally required; they are retained, not spent. A sandworm can never go in a garrison, and cannot be summoned at those three protected Conflicts until the Wall is removed.
a.evidence: Sandworms; Makers; Board Space Guide; Shield Wall

b.answer: At an unoccupied Maker space, add 1 spice to its bonus spot during Makers; visiting gains all bonus spice there. Deep Desert (3 water) offers 4 base spice or, with Hooks, 2 sandworms; Hagga Basin (1 water) offers 2 base spice or, with Hooks, 1 worm. Worms cannot be summoned to Arrakeen, Spice Refinery or Imperial Basin while Shield Wall remains; removing it allows any Conflict. Hooks are required only when specified by the effect and are retained, not spent. Worms are placed directly in your Conflict quadrant, never garrison.
b.evidence: Phase 4: Makers; Sandworms; Board Space Guide.
